verbs.name: screen_record.scene_activate
verbs.description: Durably switch one active Recording Scenes capture to one exact frozen named Screen or Presenter PiP preset. The server issues logical_media_time_ms only from that capture's shared CaptureClock and appends the reducer-validated event before acknowledging it. A Presenter PiP activation requires a selected admitted live camera at this point; a catalog may still contain Presenter while an initial Screen capture starts without one. Requires an open project and a live capture returned by screen_record.start.

capture_id.description: Live capture id returned by screen_record.start.

preset_revision.description: Exact non-zero revision for scene_id; stale revisions fail closed.

verbs.result: {capture_id, saved:true, scene_id, preset_revision, logical_media_time_ms, scene} — saved:true acknowledges the canonical durable journal event; scene is the exact reducer projection at that CaptureClock time.

verbs.name: screen_record.scene_timer
verbs.description: Durably change the one capture-wide Recording Scenes timer on a live capture. pause, resume, reset, restart, and end map to the existing reducer events at one shared CaptureClock timestamp; reset/restart immediately restart at that same boundary so the acknowledged state remains running, paused, or ended. Requires an open project and a live capture returned by screen_record.start.

capture_id.description: Live capture id returned by screen_record.start.

action.description: One bounded timer transition; unsupported/invalid reducer transitions fail closed.

verbs.result: {capture_id, action, state:"running"|"paused"|"ended", logical_media_time_ms, scene} — action and state are exact durable acknowledgements; scene is the reducer projection at that CaptureClock time.
